guide_enrichment.narrative: For us, the case is less about Maryland’s recent results and more about an offense that appears capable of sustaining drives against Virginia Tech. Malik Washington has completed 53 of 72 passes for 533 yards without an interception, while Maryland has yet to commit a turnover. That ball security matters because our numbers also identify a potential opening in Maryland’s ability to create scoring opportunities against a Virginia Tech defense that has struggled to prevent them.
guide_enrichment.matchup_to_watch:
The matchup we are watching is Virginia Tech’s rushing offense against Maryland’s run defense. Our numbers give Virginia Tech a substantial advantage there, and Overton Jr. has already produced 151 yards at 6.57 yards per carry with two touchdowns. Maryland held UConn to 67 rushing yards, but we are not treating one strong result as proof that the longer-run concern has disappeared.

Virginia Tech’s pressure is another real test: it leads the FBS with 12 sacks through two games. If Maryland protects Washington well enough to keep the passing game on schedule, we think its advantage in creating scoring opportunities can outweigh the rushing mismatch. That is the football path supporting our position, with Virginia Tech’s ground game representing the clearest threat to it.

recent_game.fact: Maryland improved to 2-0 with a 38-14 road win over UConn on Sept. 12.
Maryland produced 475 total yards, 27 first downs and no turnovers against UConn while possessing the ball for 35:31.
Maryland rushed for 125 yards and three touchdowns against UConn and had two second-quarter scoring drives of at least 90 yards.
Maryland held UConn to 223 total yards, 67 rushing yards, 12 first downs and 3-of-11 third-down conversions.
Maryland recorded five sacks and forced one UConn fumble, which the Terps recovered.

opponent_notes.fact: Virginia Tech enters the matchup 2-0 in its first season under head coach James Franklin.
Virginia Tech quarterback Grunkemeyer has completed 48 of 62 passes for 551 yards and four touchdowns through two games.
Virginia Tech running back Overton Jr. has rushed for 151 yards at 6.57 yards per carry with two touchdowns.
Virginia Tech receiver Reynolds has 13 receptions for 158 yards and three touchdowns.
Virginia Tech leads the FBS with 12 sacks through its first two games.

quarterback.fact: Maryland starting quarterback Malik Washington is 53-of-72 for 533 yards, three touchdowns and no interceptions through two games.
Washington completed 34 of 41 passes for 347 yards and two touchdowns against UConn, including a program-record 18 consecutive completions.
Washington started all 12 games as a true freshman in 2025 and passed for 2,963 yards and 17 touchdowns.
Transfer backup quarterback Cardell Williams completed 4 of 5 passes for 60 yards and a touchdown and rushed for 49 yards in the opener against Hampton.
